high_level_description: The image depicts a close-up view of a wall-mounted illuminated logo at night. The logo is designed to resemble a stylized flower or petal pattern, with multiple layers of petals radiating outward from the center. The petals are outlined in white light, creating a glowing effect against the dark background. The central part of the logo is filled with a deep purple hue, which contrasts sharply with the white outlines. The setting appears to be outdoors, as indicated by the darkness surrounding the logo and the textured surface of the wall on which it is mounted.
